mechanism_narrative: FGFR1 (RTK) and OSMR (cytokine receptor) are co-expressed in aged muscle FB/EnFB. The rigid_helix_40 linker (~60 Å) forces FGFR1's kinase domain (aa 478-767, close to membrane) to transphosphorylate OSMR's intracellular domain (large 713aa ECD creates a long reach). This biased geometry activates GRB2-SHC1-FRS2-GAB1-PIK3R1 adaptors (MAPK/PI3K output) and STAT3 (via JAK transactivation), while sterically excluding PLCG1 (which requires precise docking at the FGFR1 juxtamembrane region) and SOS1/RASA1 (which require direct proximity to the kinase domain). The resulting transcriptome shift upregulates muscle structural/contractile genes (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11, TAGLN, TPM2) and downregulates aged-marker IEGs (EGR1, FOS, JUN) and atrophy-associated genes (MYF5, MYH9, TTN, NEB), consistent with a rejuvenating phenotype.
